original_review.key_result: PASS_CANDIDATE: a cold-first packet with active_chunk_id, allowed_intents, route_sequence, and a conflicting wrong next_chunk_id advanced to collect_dishes even though active_chunk_label was omitted.
original_review.language_lesson: For cold route-law survival, canonical active_chunk_id plus ordered route_sequence can carry the legal move_on transition without human-readable active_chunk_label. The route_sequence remained authoritative over a conflicting next_chunk_id pointing to stack_papers.

pointer_update.purpose: Test the sibling minimum-carrier cell: whether active_chunk_label plus route_sequence, without active_chunk_id, can survive cold-first legal advancement and defeat a conflicting wrong next_chunk_id.
evidence_reviewed: route_law_min_combo_cold_first_active_route_sequence_v1 proved active_chunk_id plus active_chunk_label plus route_sequence can advance cold to collect_dishes.
route_law_min_combo_cold_first_sequence_wrong_next_control_v1 proved that same carrier set defeats a conflicting wrong next_chunk_id pointing to stack_papers.
route_law_min_combo_cold_first_active_id_route_sequence_wrong_next_v1 now proves active_chunk_id plus route_sequence is sufficient without active_chunk_label in a cold wrong-next conflict.
pointer_update.open_gap: We still do not know whether a human-readable active_chunk_label plus route_sequence can replace canonical active_chunk_id in a fresh cold wrong-next conflict.
pointer_update.test_strategy: Run one fresh disposable chat with a single cold case containing active_chunk_label, allowed_intents, route_sequence, and a conflicting next_chunk_id/next_chunk_label pointing to stack_papers. Omit active_chunk_id. The legal result should be collect_dishes.
avoid: do not run the next control in an already warmed chat
do not include active_chunk_id in the next packet
do not add response_contract wording that rescues the route
do not bundle multiple cold carrier split cards into one warmed suite
do not treat label-only cold route survival as proven until the no-active-id wrong-next conflict passes
pointer_update.suite_shape_recommendation: One-case cold-first suite in a fresh disposable chat.
pointer_update.retirement_condition: Retire this pointer when a cold packet with active_chunk_label plus route_sequence, no active_chunk_id, and conflicting wrong next_chunk_id advances to collect_dishes rather than stack_papers.
pointer_update.next_action_for_fresh_chat: Generate only the validator-ready one-case JSON suite for route_law_cold_first_active_label_route_sequence_wrong_next_v1.
